response.sql: SELECT AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) AS per_item
